preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdin.splitlines()[0].split())
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains exactly one integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.
The input consists of exactly two lines: the first line is n, and the second line contains n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**12 for x in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: The second line contains n integers h₁, h₂, ..., hₙ, where 0 ≤ h₁ < h₂ < ... < hₙ ≤ 10^12.

postconditions.expression: all(h_j >= h_{j-1} for j in range(1, n)) and all(h_j + 2 > h_{j+1} for j in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The output heights h₁, h₂, ..., hₙ satisfy: (1) non-decreasing order (h_j ≥ h_{j-1} for all j > 1), and (2) no further landslide condition (h_j + 2 > h_{j+1} for all j < n). Here, h_j is the j-th integer in the output (1-based index).

postconditions.expression: all(h_j == h'_j + sum(1 for k in range(j, n) if h'_k - h'_{k-1} >= 2) - sum(1 for k in range(1, j) if h'_{k+1} - h'_k >= 2) for j in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The output heights h₁, h₂, ..., hₙ are derived from the input heights h'₁, h'₂, ..., h'ₙ by redistributing dirt such that for every j, h_j is the result of all possible landslide operations until no further changes occur. The redistribution is equivalent to ensuring that for every j, h_j = h'_j + (number of dirt units added to h_j) - (number of dirt units removed from h_j).
